### they/them

\

Hello!

I am a masters student at KU Leuven in the Psychology: Theory and Research program. My thesis aims to validate a post-stroke cognitive assessment that has been adapted for use in fMRI. This coming academic year, I will be working an internship with the psychology department here at KU Leuven, with a focus on numerosity and related decision making processes utilizing EEG and computational modelling.

Next, I aim to pursue a PhD in Cognitive Neuroscience. My interests include learning and development, as well as perception, action, and decision making. I hope to continue using neuroimaging methods to investigate problems with real world impact. 

Outside of the classroom, I can often be found outdoors hiking and swimming. I am an avid reader and enjoy different hobbies from baking to printmaking - any art found on this site was made by me.
